title: Colcannon
description: Buttery mashed potato with savoy cabbage and green onions warmed in milk, served with a pool of melting butter in the middle.
notes: Kale is the other traditional green. Leftovers fry into excellent potato cakes.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, then drain and leave them to steam dry.
Meanwhile, melt a third of the butter and cook the savoy cabbage until wilted and sweet.
Warm the milk with the green onions for a couple of minutes.
Mash the potatoes with the remaining butter, beat in the hot milk and onions, and fold through the cabbage. Season with the salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Hot milk into hot potato. Cold milk makes it gluey.

steps.text: Serve with a well in the middle and a knob of butter melting into it.
